all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
Isaiah 63:9
Quote of the Day
"Jesus Christ is … more than a friend, teacher, rabbi, minister, or prophet. He is the Only Begotten Son of the Father."
Elder Ronald A. Rasband | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
